classes.name: DB
classes.description: Class representing a database connection, providing methods for executing queries, escaping values, and retrieving metadata, using a specified adaptor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB object by loading the appropriate database adaptor based on provided parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query through the adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string value to make it safe for SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is currently active.
